rationale: Discharge initial battery energy to offset diesel while respecting pmin=12, SOC bounds [2.5,8], 10 MW discharge / 6 MW charge limits and the 2 MW dispatch step. Power balance holds each 5-min interval with all load served, no PV curtailment and no shedding. Total diesel energy = (12+17+29+35)/12 = 7.75 MWh at 92 $/MWh = 713.0; the battery yields its maximum useful contribution of 26 MWh-intervals (SOC ending at 2.593 MWh, above the 2.5 MWh floor).
